description: Russia's war against Ukraine endangers whole neighborhood, Poland tells UN. Russian aggression in Ukraine poses a serious threat to neighboring states, as evident in recent airspace violations of the Polish, Romanian, and Latvian airspace, said Poland's deputy permanent representative to the U.N., Michal Miarka, on Aug. 24.
